items.title: Keep the start of long replies in view
items.description: When a reply is taller than the visible conversation, Chat keeps its beginning near the top and leaves a strip of your previous prompt visible. The starting point stays put as the reply continues to grow.

items.title: See who sent an agent message
items.description: Chat shows the sender’s name on agent message pills and removes markup tags from the message text.

items.title: Keep your draft while a message is sent
items.description: Your text stays available while a message waits for confirmation. The sent message appears as sending in the conversation until the server accepts it. If it fails or you are not allowed to send it, Chat clearly says it was not sent. When retry is available, you can try again without losing newer text. Screen readers announce send-state changes.

items.title: Keep your place when your message arrives
items.description: When the conversation updates after you send, your message stays where it first appeared instead of shifting as the server confirms it.

items.title: Step through unseen messages
items.description: Press the scroll control once to bring the next unseen message into view. The same control then says “Scroll to bottom”; press it again to go to the latest message.

items.title: Follow the latest prompt while you read
items.description: An up-to-three-line preview keeps the nearest prompt above your reading position in reach. Select it to return to that prompt or dismiss it; it stays below the device's top safe area and respects reduced-motion settings.

items.title: See clearer activity outcomes
items.description: Assignments, completions, progress, blocked actions and refusals use distinct, readable labels, colors and icons, so it is easier to tell what happened.

items.title: Read cleaner messages and activity
items.description: Technical source markers no longer appear in messages, prompt previews or activity details. Sender names and assignment context stay clear; copied and sent text, tool inputs and results remain unchanged.

items.title: See new activity in the conversation
items.description: On servers that support it, new work items and assignments appear in order with messages and tool activity. A notice for the same event does not create a duplicate entry.

items.title: Know when activity history starts
items.description: New kinds of activity appear starting when a server begins recording them; older events are not added later. Conversations remain usable when a server does not provide activity history.

items.title: Catch up when you return to Chat
items.description: Returning to Chat checks whether conversation updates went stale. If a reconnect is waiting to retry, Chat tries again right away. Once it reconnects, it catches up on missed messages in the same conversation and preserves your place where supported; later failures continue with the usual retry delays.

items.title: Keep the latest prompt within reach
items.description: When your latest prompt scrolls out of view, a smaller matching bubble shows up to three lines. Tap it to return to the original, or dismiss it until you submit another prompt. The preview stays hidden while the original is visible.

items.title: Read complete activity messages
items.description: Tap or click an activity pill to open its full, selectable message, then close it with the same control. Standalone pills and pills inside expanded groups share the detail rail and fold motion used by tool calls.

items.title: Tool detail rails and smooth folds
items.description: Expanded tool-call input and results share a left-side rail. Conversation folds animate open and closed, and revealing earlier activity animates only the new rows. Reduced-motion settings skip the animation.

items.title: Stored summaries for activity lines
items.description: Activity lines can show short summaries that are stored and reused across reloads. Original text stays readable until a summary is ready and remains available on hover. Lines stay usable when summarization is unavailable.

items.title: Read positions for compatible hosts
items.description: Hosts with a compatible read-marker connection can record your position when you open a conversation, send or retry, scroll manually, or return to the visible conversation. Passive replies and automatic scrolling leave it unchanged. Hosts without that connection keep existing conversation behavior.

items.title: Clearer colors for tool activity
items.description: Individual tool-call rows use muted grey text. Folded tool-call summaries use a yellow-tan accent, and terminal icons follow the surrounding text color.

items.title: Syntax colors in code blocks
items.description: Fenced code blocks with a recognized language tag use syntax colors in light and dark themes. Untagged or unknown-language blocks stay plain, with text selection, copying and horizontal scrolling preserved.

items.title: Terminal icons for tool calls
items.description: Tool-call rows and folded tool groups use a terminal-prompt icon. Folded groups keep one expand and collapse cue after the count; other activity markers are unchanged.

items.title: Restore refused-action notices from history
items.description: Chat uses refused-action history supplied by the server to restore notices in their saved position and reconcile matching live notices. Older servers without this history keep refused-action notices live-only.

items.title: Clearer activity pills
items.description: Activity pills use plain wording, distinct kinds and identifiers shortened to their prefix and first four characters. Activity delivered inside message batches reaches its pills, and same-kind arrivals update the existing fold.

items.title: Keep supported activity with its conversation
items.description: Eligible activity from conversation history returns in the same position and fold when you reopen or reload. Activity after an interim reply stays visible while its turn is running.

items.title: Understand activity-history limits
items.description: Without a recorded turn end, activity with no later reply disappears when the turn ends. Refused-action notices are live-only and disappear when you leave or reload.

items.title: Activity snapshot compatibility
items.description: The deprecated liveActivityIds and liveActivityEligibleIds snapshot fields remain in the public types but are no longer populated at runtime and are intended for later removal.

items.title: Remove the Tool calls button
items.description: Chat no longer shows a Tool calls button. Available tool calls appear automatically, and tool-history loading and retry notices remain.

items.title: Send a keepalive on idle live updates
items.description: The live updates connection now sends a small keepalive while idle, without changing the connection used to send messages.

items.title: Keep your place through brief reconnects
items.description: Scrolling up in a short conversation keeps your place during reconnects. Brief tool-history interruptions no longer shift the conversation, while persistent errors still offer Retry.

items.title: Know when there are no visible messages
items.description: After loading, Chat shows a plain empty state when the loaded history has no visible messages, even if older history remains available. Message visibility and access to older history stay the same.

items.title: Open conversation history reliably
items.description: Configured conversations and direct links keep history available when there are no newer messages to fetch. Chat shows a plain empty state when no conversation is configured.

items.title: Smooth arrivals while following the conversation
items.description: When you are following the latest conversation, new messages and activity fade in while the view glides to the bottom. In-place activity updates and scrolled-up reading stay still, and reduced-motion preference keeps instant placement.

items.title: Recognize conversation activity at a glance
items.description: Activity lines now show colored pills with an icon, readable kind and short identifier or status. Folded groups keep their count and show the newest entry, updating in place while you read.

items.title: Recover live updates in place
items.description: Chat retries interrupted live updates without reloading or losing your place. Short blips leave the status unchanged; sustained failures show Disconnected after ten seconds, and recovery catches up missed messages before returning to Connected.

items.title: Recover from linked conversation errors
items.description: A conversation opened from a link now offers a way back to your configured conversation if it fails. Error notices give Tool calls its own space beside Reconnect, with a separate row on narrow screens.

items.title: Fold repeated activity into expandable summaries
items.description: Consecutive activity of the same kind now appears as one expandable line with the full count. Open it to see every entry beneath the summary; tool activity stays grouped by tool name.

items.title: Handle optional activity refusals during startup
items.description: Optional activity requests now target the selected conversation. A refusal during startup no longer interrupts a conversation feed that becomes ready.

items.title: Preserve live conversation updates
items.description: A refusal of an optional activity subscription no longer interrupts a conversation feed that is already ready.

items.title: Keep your place as the keyboard moves
items.description: Opening or closing the on-screen keyboard keeps the latest message in view and preserves your place when you are reading older messages.

items.title: Reconnect without losing your place
items.description: Apps that embed Chat can show live-update status and reconnect without reloading the conversation or losing your reading position.

items.title: Keep your place in history
items.description: Your reading position stays steady when older conversation content changes or shrinks.

items.title: Optional tool history
items.description: Unsupported tool-call history is skipped quietly while the conversation and live tool updates remain usable.

items.title: See your new prompt
items.description: Sending a prompt while reading older messages moves the conversation to the bottom so your new prompt is visible.

items.title: Conversation activity
items.description: Activity between prompts and replies appears in compact lines, with details you can expand.

items.title: Context changes
items.description: Context resets and changes to assistant settings have clearer markers that are easy to distinguish from messages.

items.title: Reconnect history and stable layout
items.description: Reconnects can retrieve messages after the newest loaded message. Activity captions keep a fixed space below the conversation so status changes do not shift the latest bubble.

items.title: Conversation stability
items.description: Idle conversations stay visually still. When live updates reconnect, Chat catches up from the newest message it already has instead of reloading settled history.

items.title: Conversation history
items.description: Loaded messages stay visible through live-update recovery, even when a recovery response contains fewer messages.

items.title: Bottom follow
items.description: When you are following the newest message, layout changes adjust the conversation immediately. Reading older messages and tapping Latest keep their existing behavior.

items.title: Tool history
items.description: Visible tool calls stay in place while tool history refreshes or fails. An unavailable tool history shows its own error while the conversation remains usable.

items.title: Conversation history
items.description: Messages you have already loaded stay on screen when live updates reconnect. A shorter recovery response no longer drops those messages or prevents loading earlier history.

items.title: Live updates
items.description: Keep reading and sending while live updates reconnect. After a refused message, sending becomes available again when the conversation is ready and authorized, without reloading. Active reply status is restored when you return to a conversation.

items.title: Conversation loading
items.description: Chat no longer refuses to load based on Gateway version or build metadata. It loads the selected session directly, so routine Gateway releases do not require a matching Chat update.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: Opening a conversation keeps you at the newest message through the first history load. Scrolling back still preserves the message you are reading.

items.title: Keyboard layout
items.description: Chat adjusts the conversation above the keyboard as it opens and closes, while preserving your place when you are reading older messages.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: Chat keeps the newest message in view as a conversation opens and its layout settles.

items.title: Earlier messages
items.description: Older messages start loading sooner as you scroll up, while the message you are reading stays in place.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: On a fresh open, Chat keeps you at the latest message while earlier conversation history loads.

items.title: Message visibility
items.description: Sent prompts remain visible after reload, even when sender information is incomplete. Labels distinguish messages identified as yours.

items.title: Transcript notices
items.description: Connection and history updates now appear as quiet, bulleted captions alongside your conversation.

items.title: Latest messages
items.description: The newest message stays in view when the keyboard or composer changes size, and after you send a message.

items.title: What's new
items.description: Chat now shows a one-time summary after an update, including releases you skipped.

items.title: Release notes
items.description: Type /settings to open Settings and browse notes for this and earlier releases.

items.title: Tool activity
items.description: See tool calls and session transitions in the conversation. Open a tool call to view its input and result.
